systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Sports headquarters
systems.tiers: ministry headquarters collects, captures and processes the data; conceived as decentralised to district level; all levels from pre-primary to tertiary
all levels of the education system; the main source of data feeding EMIS

note: The ministry's own page (2019) describes EMIS as fed chiefly by the Annual Schools Census and captured at headquarters, with modules for statistics, personnel, finance and inspection; it describes no entry by schools between censuses, so the system as this document describes it is a census and gives no fact.
